name: Every channel at a site, with its licence and holder
sql: SELECT d.FREQUENCY AS center_hz, d.BANDWIDTH AS bandwidth_hz, d.DEVICE_TYPE AS device_type, TRIM(d.EMISSION) AS emission, d.LICENCE_NO AS licence_no, c.LICENCEE AS licensee FROM device_details d LEFT JOIN licence l ON l.LICENCE_NO = d.LICENCE_NO LEFT JOIN client c ON c.CLIENT_NO = l.CLIENT_NO WHERE d.SITE_ID = {site_id} ORDER BY d.FREQUENCY, d.DEVICE_TYPE
